task_description: Build a polished, Vercel-deployable salon business + lead-generation MVP web app (mobile-responsive) for a single salon/showroom. Because the sandbox network mode (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY) blocks npm package installs (registry returns 403), the app is implemented as a dependency-free static site (HTML5 + CSS3 + vanilla JS). Core: SEO-optimized landing page with services, an appointment/lead capture form that delivers leads instantly to the owner via free WhatsApp click-to-chat (wa.me) and stores them in localStorage, and an owner admin dashboard to view/export captured leads. Includes vercel.json, SEO assets, and a README.

verification.summary: No build step (static site). All 3 JS files pass `node --check` syntax validation. vercel.json is valid JSON. Static-server smoke test: all 12 files (index.html, admin.html, css, 3 js, 3 img, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, vercel.json) return HTTP 200; index.html contains the booking form + salon name; admin.html renders the leads dashboard. No formal test framework exists (npm registry blocked under INTEGRATIONS_ONLY), so verification is the project's structural + smoke checks. Integration contract verified: main.js (writer) and admin.js (reader) both use localStorage key 'aplus_salon_leads' with the same lead object shape; admin.js injects lead values via textContent (XSS-safe, innerHTML only clears own containers). Docker build skipped: no Dockerfile and INTEGRATIONS_ONLY blocks image pulls.
